nodes.n: Sunday, 11 AM. A press conference you called yourself. No agent. No Nikhil. Two hundred journalists.

choice.t: Confess everything. The contract, the reasons, all of it.
choice.d: And then tell them when it stopped being fake.

choice.t: Take all the blame. Keep Tara out of it.
Play Sushma's recording. Show who sold the contract.

nodes.n: You tell them everything. The party photo. The suite. Clause seven. The parathas. The pigeon. The wall of pillows.
"It started as a contract. It stopped being one in Goa. I don't know the exact day. Ask my grandmother. She knew first."
"It was my idea. My image, my career. She did me a favour. Whatever you write, write it about me."
Two hundred journalists, and not one of them believes she's innocent. But a few of them believe you.
You play it. Sushma Kapoor's voice: "Her next three films are mine to choose." The room goes silent. Then two hundred keyboards.
The back door opens. Every camera turns. Tara Kapoor, in your old team jacket, walks to the table and sits next to you.

nodes.t: Everything he said is true. Including the last part. Especially the last part.
The contract was real. So was everything after it. He sent me home once to protect my career. I'm here to protect his.

nodes.n: Monday. The Board president calls. "Stay. The public has... decided to forgive you. Win the final."

msgs.t: The final is in nine days. My client's book about your marriage releases the same day.
Front cover. Your faces. Shame you two couldn't sell it together. — V. Rai

nodes.cliff: You're still captain. Nine days to the final. And Vivaan has one last act.
